description: Jack Henry & Associates, Inc. is a well-rounded financial technology company that strengthens connections between financial institutions and the people and businesses they serve, and for 50 years has provided technology solutions to help banks and credit unions innovate faster, strategically differentiate and successfully compete while serving the evolving needs of their accountholders, empowering over 7,200 financial institutions and diverse corporate entities with people-inspired innovation, personal service and insight-driven solutions. Its mission statement is to strengthen the connections between people and their financial institutions through technology and services that reduce the barriers to financial health, and since its founding in 1976 by Jack Henry and Jerry Hall it has remained committed to helping financial institutions better serve the needs of their accountholders by using more innovative technology and services.
